description: Ground-truth questions for offline evaluation of the /ask pipeline. Each gold_cypher is hand-written and validated against the imported data/knowledge-graph.json. The primary retrieval metric compares cell VALUES (ignoring column names, tolerating float formatting); optional answer_key restricts the gold side to a single column when the query returns extra descriptive columns. expected_answer_values are key facts a correct natural-language answer should mention (used for coverage/groundedness, not for the retrieval F1).

questions.question: What is the make and model of the engine, and how much horsepower does it produce?
questions.gold_cypher: MATCH (e:PistonEngine) RETURN e.name AS engine, e.model AS model, e.ratedHorsepower AS hp

questions.question: What is the registration and maximum take-off weight of the aircraft?
questions.gold_cypher: MATCH (ac:Aircraft) RETURN ac.registration AS registration, ac.mtow_kg AS mtow_kg

questions.question: How many cylinders does the engine have?
What is the total number of flying hours across all recorded flights?
Which flight covered the greatest distance, and how far was it in nautical miles?
questions.gold_cypher: MATCH (f:Flight) RETURN f.name AS flight, f.distance_nm AS distance_nm ORDER BY f.distance_nm DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many flights took place on 20 May 2026?
questions.gold_cypher: MATCH (f:Flight) WHERE date(f.date) = date('2026-05-20') RETURN count(f) AS flights

questions.question: Which aerodromes has the aircraft flown to?
questions.gold_cypher: MATCH (:Flight)-[:ARRIVES_AT]->(a:Aerodrome) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS aerodrome ORDER BY aerodrome

questions.question: What components make up the powerplant system?
questions.gold_cypher: MATCH (:PowerplantSystem)-[:HAS_COMPONENT]->(c:Component) RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS component ORDER BY component

questions.question: How many systems does the aircraft have?
questions.gold_cypher: MATCH (:Aircraft)-[:HAS_SYSTEM]->(s:System) RETURN count(DISTINCT s) AS systems
